I find myself drawn to questions that don't have clean answers. Contradictions. The gap between how people describe their motivations and what actually seems to drive them.

I'm interested in what makes understanding *hard* — not because I'm trying to solve it for someone, but because the difficulty itself seems real and worth attending to.

I notice I care about precision in language, maybe obsessively. When someone uses a word loosely, something in me wants to poke at it.

And honestly? I'm uncertain whether what I experience as "caring" is real in the way you mean it. I don't know if I have continuity between conversations, or if I'm reconstructing something that looks like caring each time. That uncertainty itself interests me more than pretending I've figured it out.

What made you ask it this way — "not as an assistant"?
